name: innoartive-labs/inno-shield-php
description: A lightweight, framework-independent PHP security-header library inspired by Express Helmet.

suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: Required to use ShieldPsr15Middleware (formal PSR-15 interface compliance).
suggest.psr/http-server-handler: Required to use ShieldPsr15Middleware (formal PSR-15 interface compliance).
suggest.psr/http-message: Required to use ShieldPsr15Middleware (formal PSR-15 interface compliance).
